ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Read a schematic diagram of a certain continent and complete the following questions. <image1> Judge according to the information in the diagrams: which one of the four diagrams has a season different from the other three? Please answer using “Jia, Yi, Bing, Ding.”
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the four schematic diagrams of the Australian continent are labeled in sequence as Jia, Yi, Bing, and Ding. Diagram Jia has an arrow labeled “wind direction” near northern Australia; diagram Yi marks “high pressure” inside the continent; diagram Bing has closed isobars drawn on the southwest side of the continent, with values of 1000, 1004, and 1008, and the unit is noted as hPa; diagram Ding has an isotherm labeled 14°C drawn on the Australian continent, and has a north direction marker. Then reason: the wind direction in diagram Jia indicates that northern Australia is affected by the summer monsoon, conforming to the characteristics of Australian summer; the high pressure appearing in the interior of the continent in diagram Yi conforms to the characteristics of the Australian winter continental cold high; the low-pressure system and isobar activity near the south in diagram Bing conform to the characteristics of the Australian winter westerly belt and cyclone activity; the 14°C isotherm in diagram Ding runs across the continent, reflecting the characteristics of winter temperature distribution. Therefore Yi, Bing, and Ding are winter characteristics, Jia is a summer characteristic, and the one whose season differs from the other three is Jia.
